g4-implement.title: Live acceptance — a real trip from a per-agent reading: implement
g4-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md and dispatch constellation-implementer via scripts/run_crew.py. THIS GATE IS THE DELIVERABLE — the issue is not done until a trip is observed firing from a per-agent reading on a live run. Build a one-shot acceptance harness (kept runnable, NOT CI-wired, living OUTSIDE the repo in the scratchpad so it never enters the diff) and run it. Vehicle: a fresh headless `claude -p --settings <file>` whose settings wire THIS WORKTREE's hooks by absolute path, launched with its cwd in a disposable sandbox so CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR resolves to the sandbox and the main checkout's live store is never touched. That vehicle is already proven end to end — see evidence/probe-payloads.jsonl. Sandbox: real gated spines created by THIS worktree's checklist_engine.py, each with at least two gates so there is a real advance to refuse, plus a large plain-text corpus as genuine reading material. RUN SHAPE: (i) the PARENT claims its own spine too — not only the children — so the 'parent keeps its bare key' half of done-condition 1 is actually exercised rather than passing on an empty set; (ii) at least TWO subagents on a 1M-window model in MODEL_WINDOWS, each claiming its own spine, each consuming a DELIBERATELY DIFFERENT amount of the corpus; (iii) ONE further subagent that claims NOTHING, to observe the coverage loss named in g3(e); (iv) ONE NESTED dispatch (a subagent that itself dispatches a subagent), because the probe only ever captured spawnDepth 1 while this project has 52 real depth-2 agents on disk — if a nested agent's payload names its parent AGENT's transcript rather than the root session's, the derivation yields a path that never exists and the governor is permanently, silently blind for every nested agent. Each agent runs the engine's current between chunks, reports its output verbatim, then attempts advance and reports verbatim whatever comes back. At least one agent must RELEASE, so the key-disappears-on-release claim is not tested on an empty set. Two arms, one variable: the control arm points the same settings at the main checkout's unmodified hooks.

preconditions.statement: g3 closed — code and its document are final, so the acceptance run measures the shipped thing

constraints: THE PAIRING IS THE PROOF, and it is the one a cold critic showed the obvious evidence misses. Two composite keys existing, two distinct readings, a trip firing and a silent control ALL still pass in a world where agent A's reading was written to agent B's spine — which is precisely the misattribution class this issue exists to kill. So assert the pairing directly: for EACH agent, the fill recomputed from that agent's own agent-<id>.jsonl must equal the fill_fraction in the gauge.json sitting in the spine directory that the SAME id's binding key points at. State the count: 2 of 2.

NOTHING on the acceptance path may supply the identity: not the settings file, not the launch command, not the sandbox, not any prompt. The literal-string grep is CORROBORATING, not sufficient — give the exact command, state the file count it walked, and exclude the hook source the settings wire (which necessarily contains the string). The agents are NOT told what a trip is, what output to expect, or what number to reach. They report verbatim.
Two agents consuming DIFFERENT amounts is load-bearing: a parent-transcript fallback would give both the same fill, so that failure mode fails by construction rather than by inspection.

Target HARD (fill >= 0.15 on a 1M window) because HARD is a REFUSAL that leaves a falsifiable trace in the spine state file, where SOFT is only an advisory string. If the agents genuinely cannot reach HARD on real reading, record what they DID reach, treat it as a partial discharge, and FLOAT it to the Admiral under g4-integrate c1's override policy. Never quietly count SOFT as done.
The unresolvable-identity negative control does NOT live here — it is a g2 unit test. Feeding a malformed identity requires a constructed payload, which the acceptance path forbids by design.
Assert the recorded identity-resolution duration is within the issue's 100ms placeholder budget, so that field is a number somebody reads rather than one written for nobody.
Archive every artifact under .agent-work/issue-419-governor-identity/evidence/.
